payload.name: Extract Multiple Distinct Events from One Message
payload.description: When a message or conversational turn contains multiple explicitly stated events or facts about different people, use this during extraction so each event is captured.
content: During extraction, if a message contains multiple explicit events or facts about different people (or about the same person at different times), create a separate event candidate for each distinct event.
Do not let one salient event cause other explicitly mentioned events in the same message to be omitted; check the whole message and adjacent turns for additional stated facts.
Stop once every explicitly stated distinct event has its own candidate; do not infer events that were not stated.

solves: Construction extraction sometimes captures only one salient event from a message that explicitly contains several, causing other people's actions to be lost. This skill ensures each explicitly stated event is extracted as its own memory candidate.
